entityDescription:
Goujon Systems is a specialized consulting firm founded by Clément Goujon, a recognized expert in Systems Engineering and MBSE for complex systems. Clément Goujon brings over 8 years of experience as a Lead System Architect and Technical Leader in a top space player in Europe and in the world. He led system engineering efforts on a wide range of programs (from SE and MBSE R&D studies up to ESA major programs). His expertise spans end-to-end systems engineering, including requirements definition and management, functional and physical architecture design, trade-off analysis, and system-level integration. He is highly proficient in the deployment and governance of Model-Based Systems Engineering (MBSE) throughout the entire project lifecycle, as well as developing MBSE new capabilities through R&D studies.
Goujon Systems is committed to helping organizations navigate the complexity of modern system engineering challenges with rigor, clarity, and creativity.

entityDescription:
Company Overview
LAM Technologies is an Italian company headquartered in Florence (Sesto Fiorentino), specializing in the design and manufacturing of motion control systems. Founded in1991, the company has earned a reputation for delivering high-quality, innovative, and cost-effective automation solutions to customers worldwide.

Core Competencies
LAM Technologies provides a complete and integrated product portfolio for stepper motor motion control, suitable for a wide range of industrial applications:
- Advanced Stepper Drives
- High-performance Stepper Motors (also called Stepping Motors)
- Customizable Power Supplies
- Supporting Software Tools and accessories

Main Product Portfolio
LAM Technologies offers a wide variety of stepper motors and drives, from basic models to advanced, programmable and network-enabled systems.
- High-performance Stepper Motors in standard NEMA 17, NEMA 23, NEMA 24, NEMA 34 and NEMA 42, torque up to 29 Nm. Integrated Encoder and M12 industrial connector version available.
- Stepper Drives (Step Motor Controllers) DIN-rail mountable, compact design
- Integrated Stepper Motors with integrated Controller, Drive and Encoder
- Microstepping and step-less technologies, also in closed loop for servo-like performance
- Advanced fieldbus support:EtherCAT, PROFINET IO IRT, CANopen, Modbus TCP, Modbus RTU
- Hadrware, Firmware and Software customization possibile

Key Advantages
- In-House R&D, all electronics, firmware, mechanical components, and software are developed internally. This allows LAM to respond quickly to customer requirements and continuously innovate.
- Customization Services, LAM Technologies is capable of providing tailored solutions — including mechanics, firmware, I/O, and protocol support — to meet unique space, cost, or technical needs.
- High Product Reliability, each unit undergoes complete functional testing, including automated and traceable processes (serial number, batch, operator, temperature, etc.). Data is archived to ensure traceability and post-sales service quality.
- Fast Delivery and Stock Availability, usually products are available from stock
- Global Presence, with thousands of systems shipped annually, LAM Technologies supports a global network of distributors and OEM partners. Technical support is available in English and Italian language.

entityName: Sapienza University of Rome - Dipartimento di Ingegneria Chimica Materiali e Ambiente (DICMA)
entityDescription:
Il Dipartimento di Ingegneria Chimica Materiali Ambiente (DICMA) ha assunto il nome attuale nel 2006.
La sua storia inizia con l'istituzione del Gabinetto di Chimica Docimastica, dedicato all'insegnamento della Chimica Organica ed Inorganica (1873) e della Chimica Applicata dei Materiali da Costruzione (1876). Questa organizzazione, originariamente destinata alle discipline della Chimica Applicata, si è evoluta nel corso degli anni in seguito agli sviluppi della Chimica Industriale e ha trovato la sua struttura moderna nella fondazione dell'Istituto di Chimica Applicata e Industriale nel 1932. Nel corso degli anni, le responsabilità originarie inerenti all'industria chimica si sono ampliate fino a includere tutte le aree dell'ingegneria chimica, della scienza dei materiali e della metallurgia. Nel 1983, quando sono stati istituiti i dipartimenti universitari, questo Istituto è stato riorganizzato insieme all'Istituto delle Arti Minerarie nel Dipartimento di Ingegneria Chimica, Materiali Materie Prime e Metallurgia, nome che ha mantenuto fino al 2006.
Dal 1895 l'Istituto e poi il Dipartimento hanno la loro sede nell'adiacente palazzo in stile classico di via delle Sette Sale nel complesso di San Pietro in Vincoli.

We are a Norwegian AR gaming startup co-founded by the inventor and co-founder of Kahoot! (one of Norway’s first unicorns), who is also a professor in game technology.
We’re making BitPet®, a F2P geolocation mobile game where players care for AI-driven virtual pets and showcase them in daily themed photo competitions. Using advanced AR, players take creative photos of their pets in real-world locations or inside customizable 3D home bases. These photos are User Generated Content (UGC) that drive engagement, creativity, and self-expression, while creating strong direct network effects and viral loops. We design the game for easily shareable content, inducing viral spread to become a global hit.
Our vision with BitPet is to make daily physical activity fun and social as players walk in real life with their BitPets and interact with other BitPeters.

entityDescription: Malnus s.r.o. is a Czech-based technology SME focused on advanced connectivity and data-driven decision-support solutions for challenging terrestrial and space environments. Our core R&D activities combine resilient wireless networking, secure positioning, and the intelligent use of Earth-observation data to create robust, infrastructure-independent communication and situational-awareness capabilities for professional users. The company’s multidisciplinary team brings together expertise in embedded systems, radio-frequency engineering, robotics and downstream space applications. Malnus maintains active collaborations across European academia and industry, and its engineers have contributed to ESA mission support, satellite-system verification and autonomous‐robotics projects. The firm’s innovative approach has been recognised by the European Commission’s CASSINI initiative, winning the 7th CASSINI Hackathon (European finals) and the 8th CASSINI Hackathon (Czech national round). Malnus is currently progressing through the ESA BIC incubation programme to raise the technology readiness of its proprietary solutions. Through continuous research, prototyping and field validation, Malnus s.r.o. aims to deliver scalable, European-origin technologies that enhance operational resilience, safety and efficiency for governmental, industrial and humanitarian stakeholders worldwide.

entityDescription:
Robert Bosch GmbH is a German multinational engineering and technology company headquartered in Gerlingen, Baden-Württemberg, Germany. The company was founded by Robert Bosch in Stuttgart in 1886.
Bosch's core operating areas are spread across four business sectors: mobility (hardware and software), consumer goods (including household appliances and power tools), industrial technology (including drive and control) and energy and building technology. In terms of revenue, Bosch is the largest automotive supplier.
Bosch has been working on NV-based quantum sensors since 2017 within its central research
division, combining expertise in quantum optics, sensor electronics, and system miniaturisation. This work led to the recent formation of Bosch Quantum Sensing GmbH, a dedicated venture co-founded with Element Six, a leading supplier of synthetic diamond. This partnership ensures a secure and integrated development path for diamond-based magnetometers, which is essential for reaching TRL 4 within the given project scope.

Activity & Mission
KWAN-TEK develops and commercializes high-precision measurement solutions using diamond quantum sensors. The company offers products and services for various demanding applications, with the mission of ensuring the resilience of critical systems through quantum measurements deployed in industrial environments.
Technology
The company utilizes diamond quantum sensor technology. It leverages the quantum manipulation of the Nitrogen-Vacancy (NV) defect present in the diamond's crystalline structure, which has remarkable properties for measuring various physical quantities, particularly magnetic fields. It has the unique advantage of combining the precision provided by quantum measurements with the robustness and ease of integration provided by diamond.

The solution supports maritime surveillance, defense, environmental protection, and combating illegal fishing, while also promoting both the green and digital transitions.
It will be offered as a SaaS model, with applications in defense, security, marine conservation, and maritime governance. The project will be incubated at TERINOV, in the Azores, with technical support from BlueOasis and HidroTwin, from which it is a spin-off.

entityDescription:
roboloon develops autonomous airship drones to automate the inspection and digitization of long-range infrastructure such as powerlines, pipelines, railways, and roads. Utilizing helium for aerostatic lift, these airship drones achieve significantly longer flight durations and are suitable for operations over populated areas due to their inherent safety. With its patented propulsion system, roboloon's airship drones have, in contrast to conventional airship drones, the same maneuverability as a rotorcraft while offering many times the flight time of conventional multicopter drones. The combination of these features has the potential to disruptively change multiple applications.

Our solution addresses key challenges in infrastructure inspection, which is still predominantly conducted on foot or by helicopter - methods that are time-consuming, costly, and environmentally unsustainable. By providing a cost-effective and environmentally friendly alternative, roboloon delivers inspections that not only reduce costs but also integrate data aggregation and analysis to enable preventive maintenance.

entityDescription:
Stellar Telecommunications is a pioneering European deep-tech company specializing in delivering seamless, high-speed internet connectivity for vehicles and passengers on the move.
Founded in 2024 in Luxembourg, as a subsidiary of Stellar Telecommunications SAS (France) yet entirely independent from it for the decision-making standpoint, Stellar integrates cellular, Wi-Fi, and satellite networks to provide uninterrupted connectivity across various land mobility sectors, including automotive, public transportation, and logistics.
Stellar's flagship product,STEER, is an AI-powered connectivity solution that optimizes network selection, ensuring ubiquitous connectivity even in challenging environments. The company’s innovative approach led to significant milestones, such as being the first to simultaneously connect a moving vehicle to cellular, Wi-Fi, and satellite networks, as well as winning the best startup for mobility EU Startup Prize.

TRIOS Renewables is an offshore renewables modelling R&D and consultancy team based in Glasgow, Scotland. We are dedicated to helping all renewable energy stakeholders make more informed, transparent, effective decisions. We are a small team but our joint background spans the entire offshore wind sector – from site development to operations and life-of-field to data analysis and digitalisation. The cutting edge of our sector is always close at hand owing to our extensive network of contacts across industry and academia. We are agile, adaptable and solution-oriented – every project is unique and so is our approach.

One of the core capabilities of TRIOS is our in-house O&M model – developed and validated in open source; adapted and matured over the years by ourselves, project by project. Our modelling portfolio includes over 12 GW of early development case studies for Scotwind and other bidding rounds in the UK and beyond, as well as O&M logistics planning, novel technological concept validation, floating vs. fixed-bottom site performance comparison, and metocean analysis among others. Through this wide variety of technical details and KPIs modelled, we have accumulated the tools and know-how to adapt our solutions to practically any site, technology or business case in the offshore renewables sector.

entityDescription:
Ericsson is the world leader in communications technologies and services. Ericsson's core business is equipping mobile networks, and the company is one of the most important providers in this field: 40 percent of the world's mobile traffic is handled by Ericsson network technology. One particularly important business area at the moment is the introduction and continuous advancement of the mobile communications standard 5G.
In Germany, Ericsson has been active for more than 60 years and employs 2,400 staff at 12 locations. Approximately 1,000 of these employees are working in the area of research and development (R&D). The headquarters is located in Dusseldorf. Ericsson's customers in Germany include Deutsche Telekom, Vodafone, and Telefónica. With the help of its technology, Ericsson is also making a significant contribution to implementing the Gigabit Strategy in Germany.
The Eurolab in Herzogenrath, close to the city of Aachen, is one of Ericsson’s largest research and development centers in Europe. Founded in 1991, we have 600 research and development engineers today, working on the latest 5G and soon 6G releases of mobile network technologies – always with the benefit for consumers and industries in mind.
